name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    # bash on every runner: Windows' default pwsh does not stop multi-line
    # steps at the first failing native command.
    shell: bash

jobs:
  check:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      # Tests that need ffmpeg fail rather than skip when CI is set.
      - name: Install ffmpeg
        run: |
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg ;;
            macOS) brew install ffmpeg ;;
            Windows) choco install ffmpeg --no-progress --yes ;;
          esac
      - name: Format
        run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - name: Clippy, default features
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: Clippy, all features
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
      - name: Test, default features
        run: cargo test
      - name: Test, all features
        run: cargo test --all-features

  deny:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v2

name: Release PR
# Run by hand: opens a pull request with the next version and changelog, and tags
# what has been merged. It needs "Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests" in
# the repository settings. Nothing goes to crates.io.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  release-plz:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: release-plz/action@v0.5
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

[package]
name = "slide-detect"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Find the slide changes in a lecture video with ffmpeg and SSIM, and extract a full-resolution image of each"
repository = "https://github.com/mizorewww/slide-detect"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["slides", "video", "ffmpeg", "ssim", "scene-detection"]
categories = ["multimedia::video"]
# Consumed as a git dependency; see README.
publish = false

[dependencies]
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false }
image-compare = "0.5"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[graph]
all-features = true

[advisories]
yanked = "deny"

[licenses]
allow = [
    "Apache-2.0",
    "BSD-3-Clause",
    "MIT",
    "Unicode-3.0",
    "Zlib",
]
confidence-threshold = 0.9

[bans]
multiple-versions = "warn"
wildcards = "deny"
allow-wildcard-paths = true

[sources]
unknown-registry = "deny"
unknown-git = "deny"

# Versions, changelog and Git tags only. Nothing goes to crates.io: `publish = false`
# stands in Cargo.toml until the owner decides otherwise.
[workspace]
git_only = true
publish = false
semver_check = false
